data.body: All 4 ACs met. AC1/AC2: recorded earlier (root cause: OOM kill of the 3.63 GiB container from concurrent whole-store reads; next-batch slimmed in 451212e377a, Linux 9-call burst peak 717 MB vs 4,967 MB baseline, so no concurrency queue was needed). AC3: tests/unit/test_mcp_concurrent_reads.py drives the real build_server() with 9 concurrent next_batch calls while a slowed show_ticket is held; it fails with the sync-tool offload disabled. AC4: docs/mcp-client-setup.md Troubleshooting now names journalctl -t rebar-mcp, the kernel OOM-kill query, journalctl -t rebar-health, and stdio stderr. AC3/AC4 landed as Gerrit 3141 (merged 38f5b6c262f8, 2026-10-29 17:13 PDT, LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1); journald logging confirmed live on the deployed container (see creatable-isleted-kusimanse).
